name: Rajisha Vijayan
bio:
Rajisha Vijayan (born July 15, 1991) is an Indian actress who works predominantly in Malayalam and Tamil cinema, alongside appearances in Telugu films. After working as a television presenter, she made her feature film acting debut in *Anuraga Karikkin Vellam* (2016), winning the Kerala State Film Award for Best Actress.

She gained wider recognition with her titular role in the coming-of-age drama *June* (2019), followed by *Finals* (2019) and *Stand Up* (2019). Her subsequent Malayalam releases included *Love* (2020), the sports drama *Kho Kho* (2021), *Ellam Sheriyakum* (2021), *Keedam* (2022), and *Malayankunju* (2022).  In 2021, Vijayan made her Tamil cinema debut in *Karnan*, followed by the legal drama *Jai Bhim* (2021) and the spy action film *Sardar* (2022). That same year, she made her Telugu debut in *Ramarao on Duty* (2022). Her later credits include *Pakalum Paathiravum* (2023), the comedy drama *Madhura Manohara Moham* (2023), and *Kollamkaval* (2025).
